title: Research-Grade DICOM De-Identification & Privacy Engine
text: dicomtk package provides high-throughput, research-grade DICOM de-identification engine implemented natively C++17 zero external OS crypto Python dependencies. adheres strictly DICOM PS3.15 Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile (including 10 standard PS3.15 options) supports composable statutory jurisdiction overlays across global privacy frameworks. Key architectural highlights include: Pure C++17 Cryptography: RFC 2898 PBKDF2, RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256, RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD, deterministic 2.25.<128-bit> UID mapping, Howard Hinnant C++ date shifting. Composable Jurisdictions: 8 statutory overlays (hipaa_safe_harbor, hipaa_limited_dataset, gdpr_eu, sg_pdpa_hib, my_pdpa_2024, au_privacy_act, uk_gdpr, ca_pipeda) resolved using strictest-wins monotonic action lattice (D > Z > X > K). Single-Pass Recursive Mutator: -memory mutation across dataset tags arbitrary nested Sequence Items (VR=SQ) trees safe-private retention orphan creator pruning. Encrypted Longitudinal Crosswalk: ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated crosswalk preserving patient-level UID linkages date offsets without exposing plaintext identities. Pixel PHI & 3D Defacing: Ultrasound burned-text detection C++17 Fast Marching Method (Telea) inpainting 3D facial plane cutting volumetric CT/MR head scans. Verification & Risk Audit: 18-canary residual PHI auditing, HMAC-SHA256 signed tamper-evident compliance attestations, cohort kk-anonymity re-identification risk scoring.

title: 3D/4D Volume Geometry, Spatial Transforms, and NIfTI Export
text: Medical cross-sectional imaging (CT, MR, PET, SPECT) inherently captures 3D volumes across space time. However, different software ecosystems adopt contrasting spatial coordinate systems: +X+X: towards patient’s Left +Y+Y: towards patient’s Posterior +Z+Z: towards patient’s Superior (head) Defined ImageOrientationPatient (FcolF_{col}, FrowF_{row} direction cosines) ImagePositionPatient (S0S_0). +X+X: towards patient’s Right (inverted LPS) +Y+Y: towards patient’s Anterior (inverted LPS) +Z+Z: towards patient’s Superior Represented 4×44 \times 4 homogeneous affine transformation matrix (sform) quaternion rotation (qform). dicomtk v0.2.0 introduces end--end, standards-compliant 3D/4D volume processing: - dicom_volume: S3 class binding numerical voxel arrays analytical affine matrices slice metadata. - read_dicom_volume(): Geometry-aware reader multi-slice directories enhanced multi-frame DICOM IODs. - dicom_orientation(), dicom_to_lps(), dicom_to_ras(): Lossless spatial transformations. - dicom_pet_suv(), dicom_apply_voi_lut(), dicom_mr_rescale(): Modality-specific quantitative physics calibrations. - write_nifti(): dcm2niix-compatible NIfTI-1 export BIDS JSON sidecars.
code: library(dicomtk)

what: 3. Transforming Between LPS and RAS Coordinate Spaces
title: 3D/4D Volume Geometry, Spatial Transforms, and NIfTI Export
text: interface cleanly DICOM clinical viewers (LPS) neuroimaging packages like FSL, SPM, ANTs, FreeSurfer (RAS), use dicom_to_ras() (to_ras()) dicom_to_lps() (to_lps()): to_ras() to_lps() premultiply affine direction diag(c(-1, -1, 1, 1)) (180-degree rotation around Superior ZZ axis, det⁡=+1\det = +1) without permuting -memory voxel arrays, preserving right-handedness physical world correspondence.

title: 3D/4D Volume Geometry, Spatial Transforms, and NIfTI Export
text: PET scanners record radioactivity concentrations (BQML). dicom_pet_suv() calculates SUV normalized patient Body Weight (bw), Lean Body Mass (lbm), Body Surface Area (bsa), radioactive half-life decay compensation:
code: pet_dir <- tempfile("phantom_pet_") dicom_synthesize(out_dir = pet_dir, modality = "PT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 2L), phi = FALSE) pet_vol <- read_dicom_volume(pet_dir)  # Compute body-weight SUV (g/ml) pet_suv <- dicom_pet_suv(pet_vol, method = "bw") pet_suv #> <dicom_volume [PT] 16x16x2 | coord=LPS | units=g/ml> #>   spacing: (1, 1, 2.5) mm | origin: (-16, -16, 0) mm #>   frame_meta: 2 row(s) | provenance: 2 step(s) unlink(pet_dir, recursive = TRUE)

code: mg_dir <- tempfile("phantom_mg_") dicom_synthesize(out_dir = mg_dir, modality = "MG", dims = c(16L, 16L, 1L), phi = FALSE) mg_vol <- read_dicom_volume(mg_dir)  mg_viewable <- dicom_apply_voi_lut(mg_vol) range(mg_viewable$voxels) #> [1] 0.3392436 0.8779687 unlink(mg_dir, recursive = TRUE)

title: 3D/4D Volume Geometry, Spatial Transforms, and NIfTI Export
text: Philips MR scanners store console display rescale parameters (0028,1052) / (0028,1053) alongside private quantitative scaling intercept (2005,100D) (ScaleIntercept) slope (2005,100E) (ScaleSlope). dicom_mr_rescale() recovers floating-point physical values P=D/(RS⋅SS)P = D / (RS \cdot SS) per Chenevert et al. (2014):
code: mr_dir <- tempfile("phantom_mr_") dicom_synthesize(   out_dir = mr_dir,   modality = "MR",   dims = c(16L, 16L, 2L),   extra_tags = list(     RescaleIntercept = "0",     RescaleSlope = "2.0",     "(2005,100D)" = "0",     "(2005,100E)" = "4.0"   ),   phi = FALSE ) mr_vol <- read_dicom_volume(mr_dir) mr_phys <- dicom_mr_rescale(mr_vol, philips_float = TRUE) mr_phys #> <dicom_volume [MR] 16x16x2 | coord=LPS> #>   spacing: (1, 1, 2.5) mm | origin: (-16, -16, 0) mm #>   frame_meta: 2 row(s) | provenance: 2 step(s) unlink(mr_dir, recursive = TRUE)

what: 5. Exporting to NIfTI-1 with BIDS Sidecar (write_nifti())
title: 3D/4D Volume Geometry, Spatial Transforms, and NIfTI Export
text: write_nifti() writes standards-compliant NIfTI-1 (.nii) files matching Chris Rorden’s dcm2niix specification: Exact sform affine matrix RAS coordinate space. Exact qform quaternion rotation derived via polar SVD decomposition. Companion BIDS JSON sidecar (<filename>.json) capturing scanner parameters (RepetitionTime, EchoTime, SliceThickness, SpacingBetweenSlices).
code: out_nii <- tempfile(fileext = ".nii") bids_json <- sub("\\.nii$", ".json", out_nii) write_nifti(vol, out_nii, json_sidecar = TRUE)  file.exists(out_nii) #> [1] TRUE file.exists(bids_json) #> [1] TRUE  # Clean up unlink(c(synth_dir, out_nii, bids_json), recursive = TRUE)
